closed_findings: Preserve explicit lifestyle, hobbies, resource, work and location facts in active Stage1/Stage2 prompts; unknown is not zero or no workplace.
Select source-linked personal circumstances and temporally diverse experiences; diagnostic call metadata cannot displace substantive evidence.
Separate facts, inferences, current values, publicly stated priorities, conditional positions and important unknowns.
Preserve original answers and stances when public links are missing; never regenerate silently or remove them from denominators.
Bind archived facility classification to frozen POI registry hash without changing executed events or receipts.
Generic golf range and district alone cannot prove indoor-policy target status.
Return the same sealed stance record written to disk; all four execute-probe records retain correct review references.
Keep v1/v2 measurement contracts separate, including downstream fitted text clusters.

synthetic_probes.four_case_execute_path_test: mocked transport and tokenizer only; exact LG tokenizer checked separately in audit

limitations: Exact quotes and structural richness do not prove semantic support, consistency, causal truth or realistic human opinion.
Public-quality flags require review; no minimum word count, forced opposing position or invented biography is used.
The input is a bounded source-linked selection with explicit omitted items, periods and work limits.
Stage2 still uses the existing paid-visit and positive proposed spend model; proposal versus actual receipt remains separate.
Actual model adherence, truncation rate, full-cohort context lengths, review scores, cost and throughput require an LG SGLang pilot.
The report economics are not individual policy stance truth; compatible independent truth remains necessary for empirical attitude evaluation.
